`enum CoreShader`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.bridge.render.shader.source` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [CoreShader.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/bridge/render/shader/source/CoreShader.java)

The JOID GLSL shaders of the core, which draw text, shapes, lines and the built-in effects on every backend.

## Description

Each constant names a folder of `/assets/shaders/` in the core jar, with a `.vsh` vertex stage and a `.fsh` fragment stage written in JOID GLSL.
A backend translates and compiles all of them: `compilesCoreShaders` of the render contract suite checks it.

- [Shader translation](/build/shader-translation/#from-source-to-program)

| [`ShaderSource`](/reference/pipeline/shadersource/) | [read](#CoreShader-method-read)(ShaderStage stage) | Reads the source of one stage into a [`ShaderSource`](/reference/pipeline/shadersource/). |
| [`IShader`](/reference/bridges/ishader/) | [create](#CoreShader-method-create)(BlendState blend) | Creates the shader through the render bridge of `BridgeHandler.RENDER`, with this blending. |

## Values

| Value | Summary |
|---|---|
| [`BITMAP`](#CoreShader-value-BITMAP) | Draws the cells of a bitmap font. |
| [`BLUR`](#CoreShader-value-BLUR) | Blurs a texture along one axis, for [`BlurNodeEffect`](/reference/effects/blurnodeeffect/) and its shader pass. |
| [`BORDER`](#CoreShader-value-BORDER) | Outlines the opaque pixels of a texture, outside or inside their edge, for [`BorderNodeEffect`](/reference/effects/bordernodeeffect/) and its shader pass. |
| [`CIRCLE`](#CoreShader-value-CIRCLE) | Draws an antialiased disc filled with a color or a gradient, and cuts a texture to a disc for [`CircleNodeEffect`](/reference/effects/circlenodeeffect/). |
| [`DEFAULT`](#CoreShader-value-DEFAULT) | Draws vertices with their color and the texture of the render state; the render bridge uses it when no shader is bound. |
| [`FONT`](#CoreShader-value-FONT) | Draws MSDF text. |
| [`GRADIENT`](#CoreShader-value-GRADIENT) | Fills a shape with a linear gradient. |
| [`LINE`](#CoreShader-value-LINE) | Draws the wide and the smooth lines, through its line variant. |
| [`ROUNDED`](#CoreShader-value-ROUNDED) | Cuts a texture, a color or a gradient to a rounded rectangle, filled or outlined, for the rounded shapes and [`RoundedNodeEffect`](/reference/effects/roundednodeeffect/). |
| [`SHADOW`](#CoreShader-value-SHADOW) | Draws the blurred shadow of a rounded rectangle, for [`ShadowNodeEffect`](/reference/effects/shadownodeeffect/). |

## Method details

<a id="CoreShader-method-open"></a>

### open

`InputStream open(ShaderStage stage)` 

**Throws:**

- `IllegalStateException`: The core shader … is missing from the classpath, check that the JOID jar is complete

Opens the source file of one stage from the classpath.
Throws `IllegalStateException` when the file is missing, which means an incomplete JOID jar.

<a id="CoreShader-method-read"></a>

### read

`ShaderSource read(ShaderStage stage)` 

Reads the source of one stage into a [`ShaderSource`](/reference/pipeline/shadersource/).

<a id="CoreShader-method-create"></a>

### create

`IShader create(BlendState blend)` 

Creates the shader through the render bridge of `BridgeHandler.RENDER`, with this blending.
